description: Queueing + scheduling disciplines — the ORDER and FAIRNESS rules for serving a work queue (tasks, requests, jobs, agent steps). A registry of discipline SPECS (the serving rule, the property it guarantees, when to use it), not implementations; pointers, never truth. Composes with prioritization_algorithms (what computes the priority), worker_failure_taxonomy / the fleet supervisor (the consumers), and decision_policy (admission/backpressure thresholds).

disciplines.name: FIFO
disciplines.when_to_use: uniform tasks, order matters, no priority

disciplines.name: Priority queue
disciplines.when_to_use: heterogeneous urgency; pair with aging to avoid starvation

disciplines.name: Weighted fair queueing
disciplines.rule: share capacity by weight across classes/tenants

disciplines.name: Round robin
disciplines.rule: cycle one unit per queue/worker in turn

disciplines.name: Priority aging
disciplines.rule: raise a waiting item's priority over time
disciplines.when_to_use: anti-starvation layer on priority_queue or sjf

disciplines.name: Backpressure
disciplines.rule: signal upstream to slow when the queue grows past a bound
disciplines.when_to_use: protect a downstream from overload; pair with a token bucket / circuit breaker

disciplines.name: Token bucket (rate limit)
disciplines.rule: admit only while tokens remain; refill at a rate
disciplines.when_to_use: admission control / rate limiting at the queue edge

disciplines.name: Dead-letter queue
disciplines.rule: route repeatedly-failing items to a side queue
disciplines.guarantees: poison messages don't block the main queue
disciplines.when_to_use: fault isolation; pair with the worker_failure_taxonomy
